            function blockDevTools() {
                window.location.replace("https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Kb2yGpMaY4Y");

            // Method 1: Detect docked DevTools by checking window size differences
            function checkWindowSize() {
                const threshold = 160;
                if (window.outerWidth - window.innerWidth > threshold || window.outerHeight - window.innerHeight > threshold) {
                    blockDevTools();
                }
            }

            // Method 2: Detect DevTools via debugger execution delay
            function checkDebugger() {
                const start = Date.now();
                debugger;
                if (Date.now() - start > 100) {
                    blockDevTools();
                }
            }

            // Method 3: Detect DevTools via console evaluation
            const devtoolsDetector = new Image();
            Object.defineProperty(devtoolsDetector, 'id', {
                get: function() {
                    blockDevTools();
                }
            });

            setInterval(() => {
                checkWindowSize();
                checkDebugger();
                console.log('%c', devtoolsDetector);
                console.clear();
            }, 500);

            // Run immediately on load
            checkWindowSize();
            checkDebugger();
        })();
    </script>

    {
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@type": "FAQPage",
      "mainEntity": [
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Is the VidCore Video Streaming API really free?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes, our API is 100% free for developers. We utilize distributed peer networks and edge caching to keep server costs minimal. No API keys or credit cards required to start embedding."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Do I need an IMDB ID or TMDB ID?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "VidCore strictly uses TMDB (The Movie Database) IDs for routing. You can easily find the ID for any movie or show in the URL of its TMDB official page."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "How do I embed TV shows with seasons and episodes?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "To embed a TV show, switch the endpoint from /movie/ to /tv/ and append the season and episode number. Example format: https://vidcore.org/embed/tv/{tmdb_id}/{season}/{episode}"
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Does the embedded player contain ads or popups?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "No! VidCore is entirely ad-free. We do not inject banner ads, video commercials, or malicious popups into the player stream, ensuring a pristine user experience."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "What video resolution and formats are supported?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "VidCore streams support adaptive HLS resolution scaling from 480p up to crisp 4K HDR depending on the source media quality and viewer bandwidth."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can I use VidCore in React, Next.js, Vue, or WordPress?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Absolutely. Because VidCore provides standard HTML5 iframe endpoints, it integrates seamlessly into React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Angular, WordPress custom HTML blocks, or plain HTML websites."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Are subtitles and multiple audio tracks available?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes, our player automatically aggregates and synchronizes subtitles in 30+ languages along with available dubbed audio tracks."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "What is the uptime SLA for VidCore streaming infrastructure?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "We maintain a 99.9% uptime SLA backed by globally distributed edge CDNs across 120+ PoPs to guarantee zero buffering."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Do I need to host video files on my own servers?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "No. VidCore handles all storage, transcoding, encoding, and global delivery. You only need to embed our lightweight iframe tag."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Is CORS enabled for custom domains?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes, our endpoints feature fully open CORS headers so your web applications can load and interact with streams without browser restriction blocks."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "How does autoplay behave on mobile devices?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Mobile browsers restrict unmuted autoplay. VidCore includes touch-friendly play overlays that comply with iOS Safari and Android Chrome autoplay guidelines."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can I customize the player dimensions and responsive layout?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes, you can set width and height to 100% inside a responsive parent container with a 16:9 aspect ratio, exactly like our documentation example."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "How do I report missing TMDB titles or broken streams?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Since streams are automatically scraped and aggregated from public third-party sources, missing items usually update automatically when available in our indexer."
          }
        }
      ]
    }
    </script>

                <div class="bg-surface border border-borderDim rounded-xl overflow-hidden cursor-pointer" onclick="toggleFaq(this)">
                    <div class="px-5 py-4 flex justify-between items-center text-white font-bold text-sm sm:text-base">
                        <span class="pr-2">Can I customize the player dimensions and responsive layout?</span>
                        <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-brandBlue transform transition-transform duration-300 shrink-0 ml-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7"></path></svg>
                    </div>
                    <div class="faq-answer">
                        <div class="px-5 pb-5 text-textMuted font-medium text-sm leading-relaxed border-t border-borderDim pt-3">
                            Yes, you can set width and height to 100% inside a responsive parent container with a 16:9 aspect ratio, exactly like our documentation example.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="bg-surface border border-borderDim rounded-xl overflow-hidden cursor-pointer" onclick="toggleFaq(this)">
                    <div class="px-5 py-4 flex justify-between items-center text-white font-bold text-sm sm:text-base">
                        <span class="pr-2">How do I report missing TMDB titles or broken streams?</span>
                        <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-brandBlue transform transition-transform duration-300 shrink-0 ml-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7"></path></svg>
                    </div>
                    <div class="faq-answer">
                        <div class="px-5 pb-5 text-textMuted font-medium text-sm leading-relaxed border-t border-borderDim pt-3">
                            Since streams are automatically scraped and aggregated from public third-party sources, missing items usually update automatically when available in our indexer.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>

    </main>

    <!-- Footer -->
    <footer class="w-full bg-bgMain border-t border-borderDim pt-8 pb-12 relative z-10">
        <div class="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 text-center">
            <p class="text-[11px] text-textMuted mb-2">© 2026 VidCore. All Rights Reserved.</p>
            <p class="text-[10px] text-textDim leading-relaxed max-w-2xl mx-auto">
                VidCore API is a video aggregator service. We do not host, store, or manage any copyright-protected content on our servers. The indexing system aggregates public links provided by community uploads worldwide. If you believe your copyrighted work is being infringed, please refer to the respective source hosting providers.
            </p>
        </div>
    </footer>

    <!-- Toast Component -->
    <div id="toast" class="fixed bottom-6 right-6 bg-surfaceElevated border border-borderDim text-textMain text-sm font-medium px-4 py-3 rounded-md shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-3 transform translate-y-20 opacity-0 transition-all duration-300 z-[100] pointer-events-none">
        <div class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
            <svg class="w-3 h-3" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path></svg>
        </div>
        <span id="toast-message">Copied to clipboard!</span>
    </div>

    <!-- Scripts -->
    <script>
        let currentMediaType = 'movie';
        let docMediaType = 'movie';
        
        const btnMovie = document.getElementById('btn-movie');
        const btnSeries = document.getElementById('btn-series');
        const inputTmdb = document.getElementById('input-tmdb');
        const inputSeason = document.getElementById('input-season');
        const inputEpisode = document.getElementById('input-episode');
        const urlOutput = document.getElementById('url-output');
        const playerOverlay = document.getElementById('player-overlay');
        const videoFrame = document.getElementById('video-frame');
        
        const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
        const toastMsg = document.getElementById('toast-message');
        let toastTimeout;

        function showToast(msg) {
            toastMsg.textContent = msg;
            toast.classList.remove('translate-y-20', 'opacity-0');
            toast.classList.add('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');
            clearTimeout(toastTimeout);
            toastTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.add('translate-y-20', 'opacity-0');
                toast.classList.remove('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');
            }, 2500);
        }

        function copyText(text) {
            if(navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => showToast('Copied to clipboard')).catch(() => fallbackCopy(text));
            } else {
                fallbackCopy(text);
            }
        }

        function fallbackCopy(text) {
            const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
            ta.value = text;
            ta.style.position = 'fixed';
            document.body.appendChild(ta);
            ta.select();
            try {
                document.execCommand('copy');
                showToast('Copied to clipboard');
            } catch(e) {
                showToast('Copy failed');
            }
            document.body.removeChild(ta);
        }

        function setMediaType(type) {
            currentMediaType = type;
            if (type === 'movie') {
                btnMovie.className = 'tab-btn active px-4 py-2 rounded text-xs font-semibold';
                btnSeries.className = 'tab-btn inactive px-4 py-2 rounded text-xs font-semibold';
                inputSeason.classList.add('hidden');
                inputEpisode.classList.add('hidden');
                inputTmdb.value = '533535';
            } else {
                btnSeries.className = 'tab-btn active px-4 py-2 rounded text-xs font-semibold';
                btnMovie.className = 'tab-btn inactive px-4 py-2 rounded text-xs font-semibold';
                inputSeason.classList.remove('hidden');
                inputEpisode.classList.remove('hidden');
                inputTmdb.value = '94997';
                inputSeason.value = '1';
                inputEpisode.value = '1';
            }
            updateUrlPreview();
        }

        // Returns the visual URL that represents your API
        function getGeneratedUrl() {
            const id = inputTmdb.value.trim() || (currentMediaType === 'movie' ? '533535' : '94997');
            if (currentMediaType === 'movie') {
                return `https://vidcore.org/embed/movie/${id}`;
            } else {
                const s = inputSeason.value || '1';
                const e = inputEpisode.value || '1';
                return `https://vidcore.org/embed/tv/${id}/${s}/${e}`;
            }
        }

        // Returns a working third-party API URL so the demo actually plays media
        function getRealStreamUrl() {
            const id = inputTmdb.value.trim() || (currentMediaType === 'movie' ? '533535' : '94997');
            if (currentMediaType === 'movie') {
                return `https://vidcore.org/embed/movie/${id}`;
            } else {
                const s = inputSeason.value || '1';
                const e = inputEpisode.value || '1';
                return `https://vidcore.org/embed/tv/${id}/${s}/${e}`;
            }
        }

        function updateUrlPreview() {
            urlOutput.textContent = getGeneratedUrl();
        }

        function copyUrl() {
            copyText(getGeneratedUrl());
        }

        function loadStream() {
            const displayUrl = getGeneratedUrl();
            const realUrl = getRealStreamUrl(); // Actually fetches video
            
            playerOverlay.classList.remove('smooth-hide', 'opacity-0');
            videoFrame.src = '';
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                videoFrame.src = realUrl;
                playerOverlay.classList.add('opacity-0', 'smooth-hide');
                showToast('Stream initialized');
            }, 800);
        }

        [inputTmdb, inputSeason, inputEpisode].forEach(el => {
            el.addEventListener('input', updateUrlPreview);
            el.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') loadStream();
            });
        });

        // Documentation Interactive Tabs
        window.switchDocTab = function(tabName, btn) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.doc-content-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.doc-tab').forEach(t => {
                t.classList.remove('active');
                t.classList.add('bg-surface', 'text-textMuted', 'border-borderDim');
            });
            
            const targetPanel = document.getElementById('panel-' + tabName);
            if(targetPanel) targetPanel.classList.add('active');
            
            btn.classList.add('active');
            btn.classList.remove('bg-surface', 'text-textMuted', 'border-borderDim');
        }

        window.switchDocMediaType = function(type) {
            docMediaType = type;
            const endpointText = document.getElementById('doc-endpoint-text');
            const docBtnMovie = document.getElementById('doc-btn-movie');
            const docBtnTv = document.getElementById('doc-btn-tv');
            
            if (type === 'movie') {
                docBtnMovie.className = 'flex-1 bg-brandBlue text-white py-2 rounded text-xs font-semibold text-center transition-colors';
                docBtnTv.className = 'flex-1 bg-transparent text-textMuted hover:text-white py-2 rounded text-xs font-semibold text-center transition-colors';
                endpointText.innerHTML = `<span class="text-green-400 font-bold">GET</span><span class="text-brandBlue break-all">https://vidcore.org/embed/movie/{tmdb_id}</span>`;
            } else {
                docBtnTv.className = 'flex-1 bg-brandBlue text-white py-2 rounded text-xs font-semibold text-center transition-colors';
                docBtnMovie.className = 'flex-1 bg-transparent text-textMuted hover:text-white py-2 rounded text-xs font-semibold text-center transition-colors';
                endpointText.innerHTML = `<span class="text-green-400 font-bold">GET</span><span class="text-brandBlue break-all">https://vidcore.org/embed/tv/{tmdb_id}/{season}/{episode}</span>`;
            }
        }

        window.toggleFaq = function(card) {
            const answer = card.querySelector('.faq-answer');
            const icon = card.querySelector('svg');
            
            if (answer.style.maxHeight && answer.style.maxHeight !== '0px') {
                answer.style.maxHeight = '0px';
                icon.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)';
                card.style.borderColor = '#222222';
            } else {
                document.querySelectorAll('.faq-answer').forEach(el => el.style.maxHeight = '0px');
                document.querySelectorAll('.bg-surface svg').forEach(el => el.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)');
                
                answer.style.maxHeight = answer.scrollHeight + "px";
                icon.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
                card.style.borderColor = '#3b82f6';
            }
        }

        updateUrlPreview();
    </script>

</body></html>
